title: Distinguished cones of compact objects are compact
statement: Let C be a pretriangulated category with set-indexed coproducts [def-weil-triangulated-category]. If the first and second objects of a distinguished triangle are compact [def-pc-compact-object], then its third object is compact, with compactness and coproducts taken in the same indexing universe.

proof.text: Shifts of a compact object [def-pc-compact-object] are compact. Use the adjunction of the shift equivalence with its inverse and the inverse-shift coproduct comparison. The componentwise Hom additive equivalences induce a direct-sum additive equivalence. Naturality identifies the shifted comparison with the original compactness comparison conjugated by these equivalences, proving bijectivity. This is the sole compact_shift proof, exposed for CompactObjectsThick to reuse.

For a distinguished triangle [def-weil-triangulated-category], Hom(-,A_j) is exact: a kernel map factors through the following triangle morphism by Mathlib Triangle.yoneda_exact₂; consecutive morphisms compose to zero. Apply this to the triangle and two rotations. Direct sums preserve this exactness: if an element maps to zero, each component is in the image; choose component preimages and sum them over its finite support. Conversely, the composite vanishes componentwise. This argument is fully proved by the private helpers triangle_hom_exact and directSum_exact.

Compare the direct-sum exact row on Hom(Y[1],A_j), Hom(X[1],A_j), Hom(Z,A_j), Hom(Y,A_j), Hom(X,A_j) with the Hom row into the coproduct of A_j. Precomposition commutes with the canonical comparisons, proved on single supported components. Four comparisons are bijective by compactness of X,Y and their shifts. Apply the five lemma [lem-weil-pbc-five-lemma], using its additive-group formulation AddMonoidHom.bijective_of_surjective_of_bijective_of_bijective_of_injective from Mathlib.Algebra.FiveLemma. The central comparison for Z is bijective for every family. The sole compact_comparison_naturality proof is exposed for CompactObjectsThick to reuse.

theorem compact_cone
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ]
    [Preadditive C] [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive]
    [Pretriangulated C] [HasCoproducts.{w} C]
    (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C)
    (h₁ : IsCompactObject T.obj₁) (h₂ : IsCompactObject T.obj₂) :
    IsCompactObject T.obj₃
